verdict.rationale: Token2's core product is physical FIDO2/PIV security keys. Its management software consists of open-source desktop, mobile and CLI tools that already run locally on the user's device. There is no hosted server or SaaS component that could be self-hosted, so the self-hosting axis is a category error for this product type, and the open-source local tools do not change that.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
